_readme: SAMPLE DATA — replace these parties with the real guest list before sharing the site.
Each party is one household/invitation: a unique `id` (any short string, it is what shows up in the RSVP sheet) and the full names of every guest, spelled the way they will type them.
Guests find their party by typing their first and last name; matching is case- and accent-insensitive and tolerates small typos.
This file is public (it is in a public GitHub repo and downloadable from the site), so keep it to names only — no emails, phone numbers, or addresses.
